lessons.title: Practice Immutable Set Field
lessons.description: Implement set_field(state, key, value) returning a new dict. The test checks that set_field(s, 'a', 2)['a'] equals 2; s['a'] equals 1.
learning_objectives: Depot clerks recount crates before dawn, and immutably update state fields.
lessons.solution_code:
def set_field(state, key, value):
    out = dict(state)
    out[key] = value
    return out

lessons.title: Practice Derived Selector
lessons.description: Implement select_active(items) returning those with active True. The test checks that select_active([{'active': True}, {'active': False}]) equals [{'active': True}].
learning_objectives: Plaza clerks recount crates before dawn, and derive views from state.
lessons.solution_code:
def select_active(items):
    return [it for it in items if it.get('active')]
